shortVersion: I am a biomedical engineer who lost her mother to ovarian cancer at age 19. Since, I have been eager to learn more about the illness and current efforts to diagnose it at an earlier stage.

facts.v: Ovarian cancer research, ML & AI applications in oncology

Charlotte completed her bachelor's and master's degree in biomedical engineering at Imperial College London. Throughout her studies, she focused on computational modeling and machine learning applications. She then worked as an AI Engineer for a medical fintech company before finding her current position as trainee at Siemens Healthineers.
